mapper.select: select 'TASK' as CD_TYPE, ID_TASK as ID_BIZ, ID_PROJECT, NAME_TASK as NAME_TITLE, CD_DESCRIPTION as CD_CONTENT, DT_CREATE from task where ID_PROJECT = #{idProject,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FLAG_DELETE <> 'Y' and (NAME_TASK like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or CD_DESCRIPTION like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')) order by DT_CREATE desc limit #{limit}

select 'DOC' as CD_TYPE, ID_FILE as ID_BIZ, ID_PROJECT, NAME_FILE as NAME_TITLE, CD_COMMENT as CD_CONTENT, DT_UPLOAD as DT_CREATE from project_task_file where ID_PROJECT = #{idProject,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (NAME_FILE like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or CD_COMMENT like concat('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')) order by DT_UPLOAD desc limit #{limit}

select 'TASK' as CD_TYPE, t.ID_TASK as ID_BIZ, t.ID_PROJECT as ID_PROJECT, t.NAME_TASK as NAME_TITLE, t.CD_DESCRIPTION as CD_CONTENT, t.DT_CREATE as DT_CREATE, p.NAME_PROJECT as NAME_PROJECT from task t join projects p on p.ID_PROJECT = t.ID_PROJECT where p.ID_INSTITUTION = #{idInstitution,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t.FLAG_DELETE <> 'Y' and match(t.NAME_TASK, t.CD_DESCRIPTION) against(#{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR} in natural language mode) order by t.DT_CREATE desc limit #{limit}
